draft_text: Under 10% label noise, Thornbill-NER's F1 dropped by only 0.6 points, within the pre-specified robustness criterion.
rationale: The package only reports original-label results (T1) and seed spread; no label-noise perturbation, no 10% noise condition, and no 0.6-point drop are present. The cited T2.r1 does not exist. The claim is unsupported.
